title: NIF 慣性融合能量邊界
subcategoryTitle: 核融合：工程系統與其他路線
subcategoryTitleEn: Fusion: engineering systems and other approaches
summary: 以高能雷射、增益定義與設施能量解析NIF 慣性融合能量邊界：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore NIF inertial-fusion energy boundaries through high-energy lasers, gain definitions and facility energy: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.
v30Focus: 慣性約束融合的能量帳：靶增益、192 束雷射、頻率轉換、光學損傷與重複率差距
v30FocusEn: The energy accounts of inertial fusion: target gain, 192 laser beams, frequency conversion, optical damage and the repetition-rate gap

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在NIF 慣性融合能量邊界案例中比較慣性約束系統邊界與target與wallplug增益，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate inertial-confinement boundaries and target/wall-plug gain within the NIF inertial-fusion energy boundaries case.

steps.title: 約束方式與系統邊界：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Confinement and system boundaries: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對慣性約束系統邊界提出可反駁的約束方式與系統邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable confinement and system boundaries model and evidence record for inertial-confinement boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在「NIF 慣性融合能量邊界」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識慣性約束系統邊界。磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 建立約束方式與系統邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是高能雷射、增益定義與設施能量。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify inertial-confinement boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NIF inertial-fusion energy boundaries. Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of confinement and system boundaries, focusing on high-energy lasers, gain definitions and facility energy. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。
steps.observationEn: Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：達到研究目標就表示可直接售電。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A research milestone means electricity can immediately be sold.
steps.check: 提交慣性約束系統邊界的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for inertial-confinement boundaries.

knowledge.title: 約束方式與系統邊界
knowledge.text: 磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 本課架構對應：慣性約束系統邊界
knowledge.textEn: Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Course architecture correspondence: Inertial-confinement boundaries

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；達到研究目標就表示可直接售電。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: A research milestone means electricity can immediately be sold.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假想單次脈衝：到target的雷射能量2 MJ、融合輸出3 MJ，Qtarget=1.5。若wall-plug雷射效率2%，電網驅動需100 MJ；僅回收融合熱且熱電效率35%，輸出1.05 MJ；另有5 MJ輔助輸入，淨能量=1.05−100−5=−103.95 MJ。未回收雷射熱，皆為假想而非NIF實測；target gain不等於電廠淨電。
knowledge.textEn: Assume one pulse with laser energy 2 MJ at the target and fusion output 3 MJ: Qtarget=1.5. At assumed wall-plug laser efficiency 2%, driver input is 100 MJ. Recovering only fusion heat at 35% gives 1.05 MJ; auxiliaries consume 5 MJ, so net=1.05−100−5=−103.95 MJ. Laser-heat recovery is omitted; values are hypothetical, not NIF measurements. Target gain is not plant net electricity.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「NIF 慣性融合能量邊界」的「約束方式與系統邊界：架構分析」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源輸入、轉換、儲存、輔助負載與有用輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「能源站：把損失算回來」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的能源表、儲能狀態、損失項及設備範圍的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Confinement and system boundaries: architecture analysis” in “NIF inertial-fusion energy boundaries”. Draw the energy input, conversion, storage, auxiliary loads and useful-output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Energy Station: Account for the Losses” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for same-window energy accounts, storage state, loss terms and equipment boundary, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.titleEn: Heating and gain: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對target與wallplug增益提出可反駁的加熱與能量增益模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable heating and gain model and evidence record for target/wall-plug gain.
steps.instruction: 在「NIF 慣性融合能量邊界」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識target與wallplug增益。等離子體或target的增益只比較指定輸入輸出；全設施需另計供電、轉換與損失。 建立加熱與能量增益的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是高能雷射、增益定義與設施能量。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開Q、驅動效率、熱電效率與淨電的假想預算。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify target/wall-plug gain in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NIF inertial-fusion energy boundaries. Plasma/target gain compares specified inputs/outputs; facilities also need electrical/conversion losses. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heating and gain, focusing on high-energy lasers, gain definitions and facility energy. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate Q, driver efficiency, conversion efficiency and assumed net power. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 分開Q、驅動效率、熱電效率與淨電的假想預算。
steps.observationEn: Separate Q, driver efficiency, conversion efficiency and assumed net power.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Q大於1就保證全廠淨髮電大於0。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Q above one guarantees positive plant net electricity.
steps.check: 提交target與wallplug增益的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
